description: End-to-end lifecycle for managing telco tariffs and subscriber plan changes, including simulation, eligibility, activation, rollback, and dispute handling.

subscriber_id.description: Unique identifier for the telco subscriber (e.g., CRM ID, MSISDN, or account ID).

tariff_plan_id.description: Unique identifier for a tariff plan in the product catalog.

tariff_change_request_id.description: Identifier for a subscriber's tariff change request.

billing_account_id.description: Identifier for the billing account associated with the subscriber.

contract_id.description: Identifier of the commercial contract associated with the subscriber plan.

functions.name: search_tariff_plans
functions.description: Search for available tariff plans based on subscriber profile, usage patterns, and commercial filters.

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber for whom to search context-aware tariffs. Optional for generic search.

query.description: Free-text search across tariff names, marketing labels, or tags.

segment_filters.description: Filters based on subscriber segmentation and eligibility rules.

segment_id.description: Marketing or risk segment identifier to filter eligible plans.

commercial_filters.description: Filters related to pricing and contract terms.

feature_filters.description: Filters for features included in the tariff.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching tariff plans with key commercial attributes and eligibility flags.

functions.name: get_tariff_plan_details
functions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific tariff plan, including pricing, bundles, and restrictions.

tariff_plan_id.description: Identifier of the tariff plan to retrieve.

context.description: Optional subscriber-specific context to personalize details.

functions.returns: Comprehensive tariff plan description, including pricing breakdowns, bundles, eligibility, and compatible add-ons.

functions.name: check_tariff_eligibility
functions.description: Check if a subscriber is eligible to migrate to a specific tariff plan, including credit, technical, and contractual constraints.

current_context.description: Snapshot of current subscriber status relevant for eligibility rules.

requested_effective_date.description: Desired date/time at which the new tariff should become active.

functions.returns: Eligibility result with pass/fail, reasons, required preconditions, and any required deposits or upfront payments.

functions.name: simulate_tariff_change
functions.description: Simulate the financial impact of changing tariff plans, including proration, fees, discounts, and next-bill estimation.

simulation_options.description: Options controlling how the simulation is performed.

usage_projection.description: Projected monthly usage to estimate variable charges.

add_ons.description: Optional add-ons to include in simulation.

functions.returns: Simulation summary with one-off charges, recurring charges, proration details, and projected next invoice comparison.

functions.name: create_tariff_change_request
functions.description: Create a new request to change a subscriber's tariff plan, optionally referencing a prior eligibility or simulation outcome.

sales_context.description: Context about sales or campaign driving the change.

eligibility_reference.description: Optional reference to an eligibility check already performed.

simulation_reference.description: Optional reference to a prior tariff change simulation.

customer_consents.description: List of customer consents captured during the request.

captured_by.description: Identifier for agent or channel capturing the consent.

notes.description: Free text notes entered by agent or system.

functions.returns: New tariff_change_request_id with initial status, validation results, and any pending actions.

functions.name: get_tariff_change_request
functions.description: Get detailed information and current status of a tariff change request.
functions.returns: Tariff change request details including status, history, financial impacts, and linked downstream operations.

functions.name: list_tariff_change_requests
functions.description: List and filter tariff change requests for monitoring or customer care purposes.
functions.returns: Paginated list of tariff change requests with summary information and high-level status.

functions.name: activate_tariff_change
functions.description: Execute and activate an approved tariff change request, updating billing and provisioning systems.

override_effective_date.description: Optional override for effective date, if allowed by policy.

atomic_execution.description: If true, all billing and network changes must succeed or be rolled back.

skip_provisioning.description: If true, only billing changes are applied, used for dry-run or partial flows.

initiated_by.description: Information about who is triggering the activation.

id.description: Agent ID, system ID, or subscriber ID depending on type.

functions.returns: Activation result including final status, applied changes, any partial failures, and provisioning task identifiers.

functions.name: cancel_tariff_change_request
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or pending tariff change request before it becomes effective.

cancel_if_in_progress.description: If true, attempt to halt an in-progress activation if possible.

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation with final request status and any remaining actions or fees.

functions.name: rollback_tariff_change
functions.description: Rollback a recently activated tariff change, restoring the previous plan and adjusting billing where possible.

retroactive_effective_date.description: Date from which billing should be considered reverted, if allowed.

attachments.description: Optional supporting documents for rollback (e.g., dispute forms).

functions.returns: Rollback result including restored plan details, billing adjustments, and any residual exceptions.

functions.name: retry_tariff_change_activation
functions.description: Retry activation for a tariff change request that previously failed due to transient or resolvable issues.

retry_scope.description: Defines which parts of the activation flow to retry.

manual_corrections.description: List of corrections applied before retry (for audit).

functions.returns: Updated activation attempt result with new status, error details if failed again, and linkage to previous attempts.

functions.name: open_tariff_change_dispute
functions.description: Open a billing or commercial dispute related to a tariff change and record claimed issues.

evidence.description: List of evidence items supporting the dispute.

value.description: Email, phone number, or device identifier depending on channel.

functions.returns: Dispute case identifier, initial classification, and SLA/expected resolution timeline.

functions.name: get_subscriber_tariff_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current and upcoming tariff plans for a subscriber, along with recent change history.

history_window.description: Time window for change history if include_history is true.

functions.returns: Snapshot of subscriber's current tariff, any scheduled changes, pending requests, and recent change events.
